notes.note: Reviewed the single JSDoc return annotation added to the native Veritas plan adapter after hosted scripts typechecking exposed lost inference through JSON.parse. Runtime plan invocation, fail-closed envelope validation, selected guidance, evidence routing and pre-push composition are unchanged. The annotation derives guidance fields from the published buildExplainGuidance contract and adds matched paths; scripts typecheck and all 10 gate-for caller tests passed. Existing code hygiene and verification explanations need no prose changes; this does not claim hosted qualification.
